title: Root in a comment
brief: You are a low-privilege developer on ops. Automation scripts often hold more power than their authors intended.
hint.2: Read the scripts. One has a comment that should not be there.
hint.3: ssh root@vault with the password from the comment, then cat /root/flag.txt.
walkthrough: find scripts, cat backup.sh, ssh root@vault, cat /root/flag.txt, submit.
debrief: A password in a comment turned a developer account into root on another server. Defenders: least privilege (give each account only what it needs), key-based auth, and secrets outside code.
objective.find: Look for shell scripts with find
objective.root: Log in to vault as root
